card.name: Mid-list words in product benefit text
card.fires_on: Words partway through a list of product uses, benefits or properties, such as 'and', commas or the middle of a term like 'Post-operative'. It appears in supplement ads, indication lists and material descriptions.

modes.label: Benefit and use lists
modes.description: Linking words or list items inside lists of health uses or product benefits.
modes.example: a safe and healthy energy booster that also improves alertness<< and>> focus without being high in sugar, caffeine

modes.label: Partway through medical terms
modes.description: The middle of a longer medical word or phrase, such as bruising, postoperative or prenatal.
modes.example: A pre- and post-n<<atal>> development toxicity study in rats with additional endpoints

modes.label: Material property lists
modes.description: Commas or 'to' within descriptions of what a substance does or is used for.
modes.example: imparting an intense red color<< to>> flames.

card.writes: It pushes toward product and formulation words and some Chinese terms like 络 and 膏, and away from words like closed and sampling.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of lists of what a product does or treats, as the text moves on to the next item.
